notes: GPU page now shows every real adapter instead of blending them into one reading, with a picker to choose Combined or a specific GPU. Network page can enable or disable an adapter. New Temperatures page (ACPI thermal zones plus per-disk sensors; CPU/GPU temperature is not exposed by any built-in Windows API on most machines, so it is honestly left out). The health check now runs its checks concurrently instead of one after another, about 2.8x faster for the same result.
